title: nixos/hedgedoc: add configureNginx option
reason: Applicable: real hedgedoc module + wired test. Real diff adds configureNginx, but with a REAL BUG in the PR itself: configureNginx is declared as a plain `lib.mkOption {type=lib.types.bool; default=false;}` (a scalar bool, no sub-attributes) yet USED as `lib.mkIf cfg.configureNginx.enable {...}` (as if it were a submodule with an .enable field) -- this is a genuine declaration/usage type mismatch in the real nixpkgs PR, distinct from anything oba itself is being evaluated on.
targets_toml: single target hedgedoc, cfg_ident=cfg, option_prefix=[services,hedgedoc], watch=[configureNginx].

additional_raw_facts_for_reviewer.note: 16th candidate_rendering_gap instance -- but genuinely worth double-checking given the real declaration/usage bug noted above: oba resolved configureNginx (the scalar bool) as PredicateNotFound at head, meaning it found the real bool declaration and correctly determined there's no predicate ON THE BOOL ITSELF (the buggy `.enable` sub-access is a separate, different reference oba's declaration-walker apparently doesn't conflate with the real top-level configureNginx option -- did not verify whether oba attempted to resolve `configureNginx.enable` at all or whether this real bug would itself ever surface through this tool; flagging the presence of the bug for completeness, not making a claim about whether oba should or shouldn't have caught it.
